audit_logs_versions_nonnegative.name: audit_logs_versions_nonnegative
audit_logs_versions_nonnegative.value: ("audit_logs"."before_version" IS NULL OR "audit_logs"."before_version" >= 0) AND ("audit_logs"."after_version" IS NULL OR "audit_logs"."after_version" >= 0)

idempotency_records_state_shape.name: idempotency_records_state_shape
idempotency_records_state_shape.value: ("idempotency_records"."state" = 'claimed' AND "idempotency_records"."result" IS NULL AND "idempotency_records"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("idempotency_records"."state" = 'completed' AND "idempotency_records"."result" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
